reasoning_input.question_text: Find the general solution of the second-order linear differential equation d²y/dx² - 5 dy/dx + 6y = 0.

student_steps.content: Since roots are real and distinct, general solution is y = A e^(r₁x) + B e^(r₂x)

steps.description: Solve auxiliary equation to find roots r₁ = 2 and r₂ = 3
State complementary function / general solution form y = A e^(2x) + B e^(3x)
